ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: From the three inequalities, rearrange the boundaries and half-planes: x+y-3>=0, that is, y>=3-x; x-y+1>=0, that is, y<=x+1; 3x-y-5<=0, that is, y>=3x-5. Therefore the boundary lines of region M are y=3-x, y=x+1, and y=3x-5. Find the pairwise intersection points: y=3-x and y=x+1 intersect at (1,2); y=3-x and y=3x-5 intersect at (2,1); y=x+1 and y=3x-5 intersect at (3,4). These three points satisfy the corresponding half-plane conditions and form the triangular vertices of region M. The line y=kx passing through some point inside M is equivalent to there existing (x,y) belonging to M such that k=y/x. The values of x in region M are all positive, so it suffices to examine the range of values of the function y/x on this triangle. Since x>0, the maximum and minimum values of the linear fractional function y/x on a convex polygon can be attained at the vertices. The slopes corresponding to the three vertices are respectively: (1,2) gives k=2; (2,1) gives k=1/2; (3,4) gives k=4/3. Therefore the minimum value is 1/2, the maximum value is 2, and the endpoints can be taken, so the range of values of k is [1/2,2].

method.method_draft: 采用从原点作射线扫过区域 M 的几何方法。先根据文字不等式画出或想象区域：M 被 y=3-x 的上方、y=x+1 的下方、y=3x-5 的上方围成三角形。直线 y=kx 经过 M 内某点，等价于从原点出发、斜率为 k 的射线或直线与该三角形相交。随着 k 改变，能与三角形相交的斜率区间由从原点到三角形的两条外侧切线决定。求这两条临界线对应的顶点：低斜率临界点为 y=3-x 与 y=3x-5 的交点 (2,1)，斜率为 1/2；高斜率临界点为 y=3-x 与 y=x+1 的交点 (1,2)，斜率为 2。中间所有斜率的直线都会穿过三角形，所以 k∈[1/2,2]。
